supported_behavior_from_source: The operation requires an explicit named CSV header and selects rows whose decoded cell exactly equals one caller-supplied string.
Equality does not trim, fold case or infer numeric types; the output is a JSON string table with original columns and only matching rows.
Header and emitted cell source spans retain offsets into the original CSV; the artifact records the source/output digests and exact filter parameters.
CSV parser bounds, CRLF record rules, unique decoded header requirement and rectangular shape validation apply; malformed input and missing columns return typed failures.
A zero-match query yields an empty rows array while keeping the validated header; this is a syntactic table transformation, not a claim about why records match.
